'''''Epsilon 1''''' was a [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] that served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It fought at the [[Defense of Outpost D-34|First Battle of Javin]].
